title: A Generalized Stability Theorem for Interconnections of Dissipative Behaviors
summary: Dissipativity theory enables the stability analysis of complex, interconnected systems through the physical properties of their components. Celebrated examples of such stability results include the small gain and passivity theorems. In this paper, we prove a unifying stability theorem for dissipative linear time-invariant (LTI) systems. We use the behavioral approach to express storage functions and supply rates in terms of quadratic differential forms (QDFs).
